method: normal_T from canonical static rows; move cap exactly 4*normal_T; VIP optional and excluded from normal_T denominator; quartiles use nearest-rank ceil(p*n); heuristics do not simulate physics or human play
human_review_heuristics: normal_T >= 60: elevated objective budget; inspect order composition, target availability and spawn reachability
maximum-level target cocktail level and order-row count: inspect expected merge depth and whether required ingredients are reachable from normal spawn table
optional VIP resource pressure should be reviewed separately; it does not enlarge normal 4T allowance

spawn_and_merge_heuristics.estimated_planning_spawns_formula: normal objective L1-equivalent cost / (7/3); expectation only
spawn_and_merge_heuristics.target_gap_formula: max(0, highest requested cocktail level - 3); does not simulate merge-tree shape, delivery order, or randomness
